title: Useful Tags
description: This Datapack adds plenty of new tags
body:
this datapack is a **library** that adds _plenty_ of **tags**
**all the tags:**
- metal_nuggets
- metal_ingots
- metal_ingots-raw

<summary>What Are Tags?</summary>
  
**Tags** are like _multiple_ **items**
instead of making 3 recipies![Name Tag with iron nugget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f99a325f54ff4362c5ee97ce8f24831d312dd44.png)
![Name Tag with gold nugget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef57966367fed780e07ad598a439fabc51c6c1a5.png)
![Name Tag with copper nugget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a58cbe2c4380646ab86a922fbc20a382db0b6d5.png)

_**Make 1 recipie with one tag**_
![Name Tag with Metal nugget tag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63bb2328739050478c98106072cbb41df367a551.gif)


heres the **code** to _make_ a **metal nugget** _tag_

**YourPack**>_data_>_minecraft_>_tags_>_item_>**metal_nuggets.json**

```                                                                                       
{
  "values": [
    "iron_nugget",
    "gold_nugget",
    "copper_nugget"
  ]
}
```
